notes.title: Version 5.0
notes.notes:
CG

Added a propper CG gallery that can be found on the main menu and in the new datalog menu. 

Engine

Updated CoreScript to 1.6.0 (was 1.4.4)

Graphics

All the sprites are now bigger, the chibi style is gone!
Added Depth of Field
Walking on sand or snow now makes footprints
Added small dust cloud particles, when dashing

Optimizations

Multiple optimizations

Quality of Life

If you are tracking the quest for Earth Rocker tusks, the game automatically completes the objective when you have enough of them

Messages

Added new Message log

UI

Completely reworked the Battle UI
New boss health bars prevent massive bosses HP bars from being hidden away
Added new menu category Datalog, which contains quest journals, combat logs, message logs and CG gallery

notes.title: Version 3.1
notes.notes:
Audio

New Ending credits song, now with vocals

Bugfix

In extremely rare situations, if protecting someone with low HP using Isotissi's protection ability, she would protect the user from healing and prevent them being healed. This was engine issue that has been fixed.
In rare situations, battles would not end immediattely when enemy died from poisoning. This was engine issue that has been fixed.

Corescript

Updated corescript to  1.4.3 (was 1.3.3)

Gameplay

Masturbation scope has been set to none, to prevent possible issues during battles

Graphics

Changed the way FullScreen options behave

Optimizations

Numerous optimizations

UI

Victory Aftermath gauges now round to nearest pixel, for better coherence on specific resolutions

notes.title: Announcing the first DLC expansion and update that will be released with it!
notes.notes:
Everyone please welcome the Slime Queen!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632380/Helga_Euphoriums_Song__Lewd_Slime/

[previewyoutube=WOcXSWGYjuE;full][/previewyoutube]

Slime Queen is going to be in the first DLC of the game.  She needs the help of Helga and her friends with a problem in return of sexual favors and other good stuffs.

Feature list for DLC

3 new sexual pictures
One new short dungeon
One new ending
Unique permanent buff, if you help the queen!
Two new achievements
Random flavor text

The new DLC is recommended to be played on low levels but even late game power houses will enjoy the unique ending, buff and the sexual pictures!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632380/Helga_Euphoriums_Song__Lewd_Slime/

Launch of the DLC will be in June 19th!

We're also working on a huge 2.0 update!

The 2.0 update will contain various QoL improvements and optimizations but most of all, it'll bring the most requested feature from our players; gallery! You will be able to see all the pictures you've unlocked across any saves using the gallery function!

notes.title: Progress update
notes.notes:
We would like to take a moment to talk about our progress update

Lozalization

Two locales have been completely localized as of now:


Russian
Spanish


We'll try to get more before the launch of the game but any other locales may come as updates in future.

Storyline trailer

We have made a small trailer about the game's storyline.

[previewyoutube=3vuIP_QYBcU;full][/previewyoutube]

Digital Art book

We will be releasing a complimentary DLC on release that shows all the design and illustration process of the game, many characters changed completely during the creation of the game. The art book is 18 pages long and will be supplied in a PDF format.

notes.title: Our planned release date
notes.notes:
We are aiming to release the game on 14th of April 2021

Before that we're still going to make a new trailer and continue adding as many localizations as we are able to.
